_doc: Night Lord line (spec #383, ticket NL2 #401). The third class line after Bowmaster and Buccaneer to reuse the line convention: its job entry, its meso charge meter, its AP row, its bot card scores and its status-bonus catalogue. Skill definitions are in skills/night_lord.json. An undefined skill key is never offered or learned. The meter block is read by PlayerMeter's meso_picked rule (NL4 #403). 412 is selectable (`playable`, NL12 #411) and has a hub_kit (NL11 #410); JobTree.default_job() stays 212 (survivor/jobs.json default_job).

412._starting_skill: tier C: spec #383: Lucky Seven (4001344, book 400) is the starting active (slot 1) and the first skill a round learns; it is defined in skills/night_lord.json (moved from thief.json by NL7 #406).
412._mobility_skill: tier C: spec #383 D1: Flash Jump (4111006) is the mobility skill on the skill key, outside both slot tracks and never a card; it follows balance.mobility_rank_levels like Teleport and Rush. Defined by NL6 #405.
412._skill_pool: tier C: spec #383: the eight hand-picked Night Lord actives from the 400/410/411/412 books (Flash Jump is the mobility skill, not a pool entry). All eight are defined in skills/night_lord.json.
412._weapon_families: tier C: spec #383: claws only (WeaponInfo family claw, 147xxxx); daggers (133xxxx) belong to Shadower. Armour drops by the Thief class bit.
412._creation_weapon: tier A item fact: the Garnier 1472000 (reqJob 8, the Thief bit, PAD 10, reqLevel 10 which is not enforced, #292); the choice is tier C, spec #383.
412._meter: tier C: spec #383 M23: the meso charge, a counter filled by meso pickups and never a currency. 1 pip per 1000 mesos picked up, one pip decays every 6 s, +3% damage per held pip on every pool cast; NL4 #403 reads gain.per_mesos and decay, NL9 #408 adds the Shadow Meso read. Tier A fact: the art is the meso coin's animation frame, already imported for pickups. Read by PlayerMeter (NL4 #403).
412._provenance: tier C: spec #383 NL12 #411: Night Lord is playable alongside the other jobs; 212 remains the default.
412._hub_kit: tier C: spec #383 NL11 #410: the --hub / flow-driver test kit of a Night Lord. Fixture = night_lord_t2.json (the tier-1 claw kit); scrolls = the five claw ATT scrolls of scrolls/thief.json (10%, 60%, 100%, dark 70%, dark 30%; 5 stacks of 10 within the Use tab); spare equipment = the all-job hat 1002001, a second claw (1472001, Lv15), the all-job gloves 1082002 and a Thief-bit top (1040031, Lv10), all wearable by job 412; fallback_item = the Lv40 claw 1472014 the flow driver wears at Lv1 when a round dropped no equipment.

412._ap: tier C: spec #383: the Thief (400) row copied verbatim (the Thief gear pattern, no new tuning); explicit so 412 no longer falls back through 410/400.

bot._card_scores: tier C: spec #383: every pool skill is scored explicitly (learn 100, rank 74, the numbers BotInput's pool default gives every curated skill; NL11 #410 lists all eight as Hero's and Bowmaster's tests do). Shadow Partner needs its pair: BotInput._base_score alone only treats projectile / instant / box skills as attacks and the clone is a summon; the other seven entries are a guard, not a behaviour change.

balance._status_bonuses: spec #383 M22: the rarity status-bonus catalogue (NL3 #402 parses and validates it, NL2 only stores it). Tier A: venomous_star's chance, time and level are Venomous Star's (4120005) prop, time and rank -> poison level map (mad is unused). Tier C: everything about stunning_avenger (chance, 1.5 s) and both repeat_chance values (points added per repeat of the same grant, scaled by the x0.8 repeat factor).
